summary: Verified the sticky top header layout fix in DashboardLayout.jsx (translucent 'glass' -> opaque bg-[#0B1120]). Logged in as admin, navigated to /channels at 1920x800, confirmed header computed style is backgroundColor rgb(11,17,32), backdropFilter none, opacity 1, position sticky, z-index 20. Scrolled the page (window.scrollY=146, docH=946) and visually confirmed no bleed-through under the header. Regression-checked header contents (节点在线, TRC20/ERC20/BEP20 latency, 余额 pill, 平台管理 badge, AlertBell, PaymentAlerts) — all intact. Sidebar footer fingerprint (nav-security-link) navigates to /security correctly and logout-btn returns to /login. Pages /, /merchant-stats, /ledger, /channels all render with zero .error elements and no console errors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Layout fix verified. Header is opaque at /channels and scrolled content no longer shows through. All regression pages (/, /merchant-stats, /ledger, /channels, /security) render cleanly at 1920x800. Logout flow works.
rca of the issue: Previously the sticky header used a translucent 'glass' background (likely bg-slate-900/60 + backdrop-blur), allowing scrolled card content under the sticky header to be visible through it on scrollable pages like /channels. Fix replaced it with opaque bg-[#0B1120] (rgb 11,17,32) with shadow — confirmed via getComputedStyle: backgroundColor=rgb(11,17,32), backdropFilter=none, opacity=1.
